narrative: Consistency review of MTG-2026-ACME-AGM (Acme Industrials plc, meeting 2026-05-15) against policy version PXY-POL-2025 assessed 5 agenda items: 1 aligned, 2 policy deviations, 1 case-by-case, and 1 no-policy coverage gap. Overall disposition: deviations_present. ITEM-3 (auditor ratification) and ITEM-4 (climate disclosure) each carry a proposed vote that conflicts with the effective policy position and with analogous prior firm votes, cited per finding. Each deviation, the case-by-case item, and the coverage gap requires documented rationale and voting-committee adjudication; this review resolves none of them and takes no position on the merits. Consistency findings and cited evidence only; not a voting decision or instruction. This review does not cast, change, or submit any vote; a human analyst adjudicates and records the vote in the system of record.
